subject: Quick-Inspect: tenant cost label alignment & oncall handoff
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Console Product <console-product@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick-Inspect: tenant cost label alignment & oncall handoff

Team —

Quick one: Acme flagged several Quick-Inspect snapshots where spend and token counts are being attributed to the wrong tenant label (screenshot attached). They surfaced this yesterday during a renewal call and want a short-term mitigation plus a long-term mapping so Quick-Inspect tiles show the same "tenant label" as billing.

Asks:
- Can Console map the billing label (tenant_label) to the Quick-Inspect header so users see the canonical name rather than the tenant_id?
- If we need a backfill for past snapshots, what's the impact on storage / query cost?
- Who will own the rollout + a short rollback plan if this triggers alert churn?

Why now: Acme is a strategic renewal and wants clarity in the console before EOW next week.

Attached: quick_inspect_label_samples.csv + acme_misalignment_screenshot.png.

Proposed immediate step: quick sync w/ Console eng + Aditya (oncall) today to confirm whether we can add a label mapping flag without a schema migration. I can host a 30-min sync at 11:00 PT if that works.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Product Manager, Console & Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick-Inspect: tenant cost label alignment & oncall handoff

Thanks Rachel —

I dug into the CSV you sent and a quick note on feasibility:
- If the billing label already exists in our token-pathway events, a mapping layer in Quick-Inspect is the lowest-risk path (no DB migration).
- If labels are missing for older snapshots, we can populate a derived field in the materialized view used by Quick-Inspect. That backfill would run as a batch job and is expected to touch ~2M rows (rough estimate).

Questions for the sync:
- Which field in billing is the canonical label? (tenant_label vs display_name) — please confirm.
- Do we need to expose both the label and the tenant_id in the header or just the canonical label?

Quick proposal for a minimal change (can be rolled in 1 sprint):
1) Add a mapping middleware in Quick-Inspect that resolves tenant_id -> canonical_label at read time.
2) Add a feature flag (console.quickinspect.labelmap.v1) to toggle the new header.
3) Schedule a single backfill job for snapshots older than 30 days (if requested).

I created INFR-4217 to track the work and added acceptance criteria. Will bring this to the 11:00 PT sync.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal SRE, Console

Looping in from on-call —

I ran a quick query against the live KV cache and can reproduce the mismatch for two tenant_ids (see console snippet below). If we implement a read-time mapping, we should be careful about cache keys: the mapping must be included in the key or we risk cache poisoning between tenants.

Snippet:
- Current cache key: quickinspect:snapshot:<tenant_id>:<window>
- Suggested cache key: quickinspect:snapshot:<tenant_id>:<window>:label-v1

Operationally:
- Read-time mapping + feature flag is safest for a fast rollout.
- Backfill is heavier and could bump disk IO on the materialized view. We'll need a maintenance window if we run the backfill synchronously.
- I'll add an alert rule to suppress noisy owner alerts during the rollout window (two-hour suppression recommended).

I can join the 11:00 PT sync but if folks want to push earlier I can open a short incident window.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Oncall Engineer, Platform

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700

Thanks all — good sync this morning. Quick recap and owners so we don't lose momentum: 

Decisions:
- Implement read-time mapping middleware in Quick-Inspect (no schema change) with a feature flag (console.quickinspect.labelmap.v1). Owner: Kimberly. Target: M0+2 (next sprint).
- Add label version to cache keys to avoid poisoning. Owner: Aditya. Action: update cache key pattern and add a 2-hour alert suppression during rollout.
- Backfill only on request for historical snapshots >30 days. Owner: Product (Rachel) to confirm with Acme by EOD Thu; engineering will do the slot if approved.

Action items / deadlines:
- Kimberly: open PR with middleware + feature flag by Fri 20 Aug.
- Aditya: prepare alert suppression playbook + cache-key PR by Fri 20 Aug.
- Rachel: confirm backfill ask with Acme and update INFR-4217 by Thu 19 Aug.
- Marissa: coordinate QA for flag toggle and sign-off (QA checklist linked in INFR-4217).

I'll follow up with a short doc (shared Drive link above) that captures the rollout steps and rollback instructions. Please reply if any of the owners can't meet the dates above.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Group Product Manager, Instrumentation & Observability
Redwood Inference
